prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical realistic low-light phone selfie of an adult East Asian man with messy black hair, thin bangs, and a sleepy thoughtful gaze. Place him in a dark quiet bedroom with beige blackout curtains and a softly shadowed neutral wall. Use cool bluish-purple phone-screen light, deep ambient shadow, close low-angle framing, soft focus at edges, visible digital grain, natural skin, correct fingers, and no beauty filter. No exact face reference, exposed shoulder emphasis, logo, text, screen UI, or watermark.
